# ligo_secret_store (Resource)

A a secret store instance: where the platforms keep the credentials they hand out. A person decides every change to it, whatever the charter says: the provider files the change request once and waits for it (approval_timeout in the provider), and never approves one. It is never managed (there is no lock). Its config names a credential by reference, never by value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A Vault that the platforms keep their credentials in. A person decides every
# change to an instance, so the apply waits for an approver (approval_timeout in
# the provider); an instance is never managed. The config names the bootstrap
# credential by reference (a path in a store), never by value.
resource "ligo_secret_store" "vault" {
  name         = "vault-prod"
  jurisdiction = "dc/platform"
  realm        = "prod"
  type         = "vault.v1"
  display_name = "Production Vault"

  svid_selector = {
    match_expr        = "path == \"/ligo/plugin/vault\""
    jwt_audience      = ["https://vault.example.org"]
    allow_shared_svid = false
  }

  config = jsonencode({
    address               = "https://vault.example.org:8200"
    auth_mount            = "jwt-spiffe"
    role                  = "ligo-plugin-vault"
    workload_jwt_audience = "https://vault.example.org"
    allowed_endpoints     = ["vault.example.org:8200"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction that owns it; a person on it decides every change. It cannot change.
- `name` (String) The name, unique among the instances of the kind; a new name is a new resource.
- `realm` (String) The realm; it cannot change.
- `type` (String) The plugin type and version, as server.yaml names it (such as vault.v1); it cannot change.

### Optional

- `config` (String, Sensitive) The plugin's configuration, as JSON text (jsonencode); some plugins (svid, none) have none. ligo checks it against the plugin's schema when the change is filed. It names a bootstrap credential by reference (a store, a path), never by value.
- `contacts` (Attributes List) Who to ask. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contacts))
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `network_flows` (String) The network flows the instance needs, as JSON text.
- `svid_selector` (Attributes) Which SVID is the plugin's, which the plugin process of the type has to present. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--svid_selector))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name.
- `last_change_request` (String) The ID of the last change request the provider filed or waited for.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update names it, and ligo refuses a stale one.

<a id="nestedatt--contacts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contacts`

Required:

- `name` (String) A name or a team.

Optional:

- `email` (String) Their address.


<a id="nestedatt--svid_selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `svid_selector`

Required:

- `match_expr` (String) The expression that selects the SVID.

Optional:

- `allow_shared_svid` (Boolean) Whether other instances of the type may share the SVID.
- `jwt_audience` (List of String) The audiences of the JWT-SVID it sends to the bootstrap credential's store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name. A caller who may not file on its jurisdiction sees no config: the
# first plan then shows what the configuration sets.
terraform import ligo_secret_store.vault vault-prod
```
